description: This file contains an HTML document that integrates React components written in JavaScript to create a simple book reading list application. It includes external CSS and React JavaScript library references, defines multiple React components, and mounts the React application to a DOM element.

classes.name: AppHeader
classes.description: Displays the React version and the current book count.

classes.name: ColorButton
classes.description: Renders a button with a color class and enabled/disabled state.

classes.name: ButtonGrid
classes.description: Creates a grid of nine ColorButton components with varying colors and enabled states.

classes.name: NewBook
classes.description: Provides input field for adding new books to the list.

classes.name: BookItem
classes.description: Displays the name of a single book.

classes.name: BookList
classes.description: Displays a list of books as an ordered list.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main React component managing the state of the book list and rendering all subcomponents.

methods.name: onInput
methods.description: Handles input change event to update the text state.

methods.name: onNewBook
methods.description: Adds a new book to the book list state.
